subject: Bake-off credits and short-term extension request — HealthPly RFP
messages:
From: Alex Martin <alex@healthply.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: match competitive credits & trial extension for bake-off

Hi Neha,

Quick one — we're finalizing participants for the week-long RFP bake-off (scoping models for clinical summarization) and Vendor X has extended an upfront evaluation package (150k token credit + 3 week trial) plus dedicated onboarding hours. HealthPly is seriously considering their stack unless Redwood can offer something comparable.

Can you let me know if Redwood can:
- Provide an initial credit allocation for the bake-off (comparable to Vendor X)
- Extend our trial window by ~3 weeks to cover the evaluation phase
- Enable short-term premium support during the bake-off (fast response for infra/issues)

We need an answer this week to include in our procurement appendix.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martin
Principal Product Manager, HealthPly
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martin <alex@healthply.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: match competitive credits & trial extension for bake-off

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the context and the heads-up. I can move quickly on this, but I need internal sign-off on the size and conditionals. Proposed internal offer we can present:
- 150,000 token credit (redeemable during bake-off only)
- 4-week trial extension (starts on first API call during the evaluation window)
- One dedicated kick-off session + priority support for the 4-week window (response SLAs only)

Conditions: credits expire 45 days after activation; usage telemetry enabled for evaluation (anonymized); not eligible for stacking with other promo codes; Redwood to be named in procurement appendix as evaluation vendor.

I've attached a one-page summary (proposed-credits-summary.pdf) to circulate for approvals. Ben/Marissa — can you weigh in? Ben, is 150k token credit + priority support acceptable from a commercial standpoint? Marissa, can CS commit to the kick-off and priority support?

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: match competitive credits & trial extension for bake-off

Neha —

I think we should be judicious here. HealthPly is a mid-market target but this is still early-stage; 150k tokens + 4 weeks is on the generous side. My preference: 100k tokens + 3-week extension unless they signal clear intent to run a paid POC or include Redwood as preferred vendor. If they push back, we can escalate to finance for a one-off.

If we go to 150k, we should:
- Capture a written POC intent (email/LOI) and an expected evaluation plan (models, metrics)
- Tag the credits to the deal_id (HP-2026-056) and mark them as promotional (non-refundable)

I'm attaching the summary I'm comfortable with and redlines in the PDF.

-Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: match competitive credits & trial extension for bake-off

Fyi — CS is willing to absorb the priority support hours for a single kick-off and triage during the bake-off. From an adoption perspective, giving them enough runway makes a big difference in demos; I recommend 150k + 4 weeks but condition it on a short mutual action plan (attached MAA-template.docx) so we can measure success and push toward a POC.

If Ben wants to protect credits, we can structure them as milestone-release: 75k up front, 75k released after a successful mid-eval checkpoint. That reduces risk.

-Marissa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: match competitive credits & trial extension for bake-off

Forwarding my note for the record —

We can approve a compromise: 150,000 token credit (split 75k upfront / 75k on mid-eval milestone), 4-week extension, and priority support as requested, with the following commercial gating:
- Customer signs a short POC acknowledgement (simple LOI) declaring evaluation intent and expected timeline
- Credits expire 60 days after activation if unused
- Marketing usage (anonymized case study) optional but preferred

This preserves commercial discipline while making the package competitive. Finance signs off as long as the credits are tracked to deal_id HP-2026-056 and the MAA is on file. Approved.

-Jonas
From: Alex Martin <alex@healthply.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: healthply-rfp@healthply.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: match competitive credits & trial extension for bake-off

Neha —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. HealthPly accepts the 150k token credit (75k upfront / 75k on milestone), the 4-week extension, and the priority support package. We'll sign the short LOI/MAA and route for procurement. Please send the DocuSign link and the activation instructions for the evaluation environment. Also: can we get temporary dataset access for the test harness (small sample)?

Thanks,
Alex
Principal Product Manager, HealthPly
--- End of thread ---
